comment: Prof Carleton is an excellent professor. He uses technology to get the most out of his students. He makes you want to do well. That is the sign of a great professor.
amazing professor~

He is an amazing professor. His classes are interesting and engaging. He often shows youtube clips or shares a news article with us that pertains to english. He encourages you to weave in your knowledge from other classes. He collects several rough drafts before he grades your papers so its not hard to do well.

An educator by profession, a student at heart. A semester with Lee is give-and-take: he works hard to teach, but he expects all his students to bring their experience and *researched* opinions to the table. He'll entertain any opinion, conservative or liberal, as long as you back it up. Six years later and he's still as much my mentor as my friend.

Probably the most frusterating teacher that I've ever had!He does bring up interesting points in class, but also has no interest in considering opinions that don't match his own. Doesn't follow his own syllabus, emphasizes using technology in class but doesn't even respond to emails! Feels that his doctoral work is more important than his teaching!

An amazing professor...knows what he's teaching and teaches it well...proves to be very helpful outside of class...moreover, he will make you think outside the box...dont take his class if you expect to get an easy A, because you have to earn it, but you come out learning thigns you can use for the rest of your life

Amazing guy, really helpful, and just all around nice. If you need help or somthing he'll def help you, and it IS possible to get an A, I did. But yea he's a hard grader, make sure and put a LOT of time into essays.

His classes are so interesting, never boring or too long. Discussions were a lot of fun, he is a very intelligent man. You will learn A LOT and it is very beneficial. If you work really hard you can definetly pull a B or even an A.

Very intelligent man, put together somewhat interesting discussions. Very friendly in and outside the classroom, however he is very challenging. His essays and journal entries require some time and thought, but if you put in the work, you can pass. Not an easy A if you're looking to boost your GPA.

He is a good teacher who is very supportive of your ideas and helpful with essays.  He is a hard grader, but fair, and does not make you feel intimidated.  He is very smart and can give you good insight to a lot of topics.

I learned to appreciated and look deeper into what stories mean, loved this man.  His not accepting other views?  Well sounds like you all are doing that for not accepting his.  he listens to all and leads open and fair discussions.

perhaps the most outstanding professor i had while undergrad.  nothing but postive things to say about him.  very challenging, but in a useful way.  i would reccomend him to anyone who wants to increase their own awareness of themselves and their perspectivenss. :)

worst teacher ive had @ richmond... too hard and way too liberal (for me that is).  very unclear about what he expects... but DOES expect exceptional work when it comes to papers... can't satisfy the man unless you believe everything that he does
I'm a pretty conservative person but I found him very thought provoking - he suggests ideas, he doesn't impose them.

Ok, here is how it is. This teacher is far to left leaning for me. For someone who teaches tolerance he has very little. His beliefs tend to get in the way of the task at hand, that is teaching english.. Do not take this class unless you are a hard core left leaning dem.
I feel like i am the only person who doesn't appreciate Carleton.  A perfect example of how a poor attitude can be detrimental to education.

He is awesome! So fun, so smart, so interesting. What surprised me is that, although he is liberal, he was fair to all of us conservatives. I actually wanted to hate him... but I couldn't, he didn't give me a chance.

Professor Carleton is an awesome guy. This class is very challenging, but it is definitely worth taking.  He is a genuine guy and very interested in his students.  If you put effort toward the class, your writing skills will improve tremendously.

The workload is not that much if you have superior time managment skills [of which i have none] but you'll survive!  VERY INTERESTiNG!  Likes people who speak up! Took my writing to a whole other level.

Awesome teacher.  Tough grader but well worth taking the class.  I definitely learned a lot, because he challenges you to look at everything from a different perspective.  Keep up with the readings and you'll be alright.

He definitely loves the subject he teaches.  However, he is very liberal in his views and demands alot out of his students.  Compared to other ENG 103 classes, we do the most work by far!  He is a very nice guy, and the issue of technology can get a little drawn out.  Be ready to make an effort!!!
Very tough teacher, would not recommend taking him unless you enjoy low grades and massive amounts of homework every night.
hard, liberal, unclear about what he expects from you other than hard work
way too much work, i always felt like i was behind in the work because he continued to pile on the assignments. Would'ny be that bad if it was the ONLY class you took for a semester. DO NOT TAKE IT!
Really really great teacher.  Learned a ton from his unorthodox film clips and writing samples.  Found out a lot about myself as an english student and about other students
Take this class if you want to be challenged intellectually. Conversations often get off subject. Incosistent grader. Very liberal, but he really does care about students.

Very liberal and once he discovered I was conservative, he made my life a living hell.  He graded very unfairly, usually based on opinion.  He also made very very personal and uncalled-for comments on papers of mine and others in the class.
The workload for this class was unbelievable- dont take it unless you are willing to be working nonstop on stuff for his class.
No Comments

demanding teacher.  If you follow the syllabus, you'll be okay.  He will give you lots of feedback if you take the time to meet with him.  He has lots of great ideas up in his noggin and sometimes it's a pain to listen to him in class.
Great conversationalist, still meet up for coffee a year later.  Very in tune with each student, interesting reading and movie material, he's a very abstract thinker, also pretty liberal
don't listen to person who gave him a 3 for clarity. He's probably just mad cause Carleton's a prof who actually made him think critically.
expects way too much. sketchy about deadlines. same discussion every class. wants every student to become a free thinking hippie
Great teacher.  Class is interesting and fair, grades papers fair, midterm was difficult, but excellent class in general, I'd recommend it.
No Comments
Great teacher.  Makes everything interesting.
His teaching style is great and he made topics interesting. Everything is clear, there are few surprises. The class is neither too hard nor a blow off class, and he will help if you ask him to.
lots of great discussions.  Expository Writing is worth taking with this guy.
